To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) streaming video over the current best effort network is possible, but it is difficult to guarantee QoS; 2) streaming video over a QoS network is more efficient and flexible, but the network must provide QoS guarantees and the video server should be able to adapt to network changes; and 3) streaming video over multicast is difficult, but the network should provide multicast QoS guarantees, the server should be able adapt to network changes, and the clients should be able to join
the following approaches can be taken to achieve streaming video over the network.

1) video compression techniques can be used to improve video quality and reduce network load; 2) application layer QoS mechanisms can provide QoS guarantees for video applications; 3) continuous media distribution services can provide efficient video delivery; 4) streaming servers can provide a scalable solution for streaming video; 5) media synchronization can be achieved with various mechanisms; and 6) protocols for streaming video can provide efficient video multicast.

the development of new techniques and protocols for streaming video over the network.
the design, implementation, and evaluation of Internet streaming video.
the design of a streaming media infrastructure to support scalable, efficient, and flexible video delivery.
